LanguageData.WBD_LibAllSettingsTip: Opens Set my Defaults in Mod settings: areas on or off, what happens by itself, compatibility.
LanguageData.WBD_LibHelp: Everything you save lives in one library outside your saves, so every colony can use it. Open an entry to see what it holds. The round button marks the default that new buildings, zones and colonists get.
LanguageData.WBD_LibEmpty: Nothing saved yet. Select a workbench, shelf, zone or colonist, press Defaults and choose "Save as preset": it shows up here and in every colony.
LanguageData.WBD_LibAlsoUsedBy: Also used by {0} (related buildings without their own preset).
LanguageData.WBD_LibFileLine: One file for all colonies: Library.xml in the RimWorld settings folder. Profiles: {0}.
LanguageData.WBD_MissingTipKept: Nothing is lost: missing parts are kept and skipped, and work again once the mod is back.
LanguageData.WBD_ProfHelp: A profile is a named copy of your defaults for a kind of run, for example "Tribal start" or "Mechanitor run". Applying a profile makes its presets your defaults again; presets it does not name stay as they are.
LanguageData.WBD_ProfSaveSection: Save what you have as a profile
LanguageData.WBD_PartNothing: Nothing of this kind is saved.
LanguageData.WBD_ProfFromColony: Take policies and colony settings from this colony
LanguageData.WBD_ProfFromColonyTip: On: the profile gets the policies and colony settings this colony uses right now. Off: those saved in the library.
LanguageData.WBD_ProfSaveNothing: Nothing to save: choose at least one part that has something saved.
LanguageData.WBD_ProfReplaceConfirm: A profile named "{0}" exists. Replace it?
LanguageData.WBD_ProfNone: No profiles yet. Save one above, or import a share string on Import and export.
LanguageData.WBD_ProfApplyTip: Its presets become your defaults. In a running colony its policies and colony settings are applied too.
LanguageData.WBD_ProfApplyInGame: Its policies and colony settings are applied to this colony now.
LanguageData.WBD_ProfWouldReplace: Replaces your presets of the same name: {0}
LanguageData.WBD_ProfCopyTip: Copies this profile as text. Paste it in Discord or a Steam comment; others import it on Import and export.
LanguageData.WBD_ShareHelp: A share string is a short text that holds presets: copy it here, paste it anywhere, and import it on another computer or in another game. It never holds a save.
LanguageData.WBD_ShareCopyLibraryTip: Every saved default (not the profiles) as one share string.
LanguageData.WBD_ShareExportNote: Presets of mods the other player does not have are kept and marked there; nothing breaks.
LanguageData.WBD_SharePasteHint: Or paste into this field (it starts with SMD1:).
LanguageData.WBD_ShareImportNote: Importing only stores a profile. Your defaults change when you apply it.
LanguageData.WBD_ShareImported: Imported as profile "{0}". Apply it on Profiles.
LanguageData.WBD_CardPitchJoined: Nothing in this colony was changed. Choose how much happens by itself from now on.
LanguageData.WBD_CardMineEmpty: Nothing saved yet. Save bills, shelves, zones or colonists with the Defaults button, and new colonies get them.
LanguageData.WBD_CardNoProfiles: Profiles ("Tribal start", "Mechanitor run") appear here once you save one: Defaults button, Library and profiles.
LanguageData.WBD_CardAlsoPolicies: Also bring my saved policies into this colony
LanguageData.WBD_CardAlsoPoliciesTip: Creates your saved outfit, drug, food and reading policies and moves the starting colonists to their defaults.
LanguageData.WBD_CardAppliedPawns: colonist preset for the starting colonists ({0})
LanguageData.WBD_BackupProfileDesc: Kept automatically on {1}: your versions of the presets that applying the profile "{0}" replaced.
LanguageData.WBD_BackupProfileMade: Your previous versions are kept as the profile "{0}".
LanguageData.WBD_SaveFailedReason: Could not save the library ({0}). Nothing was changed; your presets are as before.
LanguageData.WBD_CardWillReplace: Replaces {0} of your presets with its own versions (yours are kept as the profile "{1}").
LanguageData.WBD_CardLibraryNotSaved: Your library could not be updated ({0}): this colony uses the profile, but new buildings and colonists get the presets your library had.
LanguageData.WBD_LibraryUsingBackup: Until then this game uses the previous version (Library.xml.bak), so new buildings and colonists still get your defaults.
LanguageData.WBD_FileErrChangedUnreadable: Library.xml was changed outside this game and cannot be read
LanguageData.WBD_FileErrFolderNotCreatable: the library folder cannot be created
LanguageData.WBD_FileErrFolderNotWritable: the library folder is not writable
LanguageData.WBD_FileErrLocked: another game is writing the library right now; try again in a moment
LanguageData.WBD_LibRestoreBackupTip: Puts Library.xml.bak back as Library.xml. The current file is not deleted: it is kept as Library.broken-<date>.xml in the same folder.
LanguageData.WBD_LibRestoreDone: The backup was restored; your presets can be changed again.
LanguageData.WBD_LibRestoreFailed: The backup could not be restored: {0}
